description: This file implements the JsonWebKey class, which handles parsing and extracting keys from a JSON Web Key Set, including base64 decoding and key lookup functionalities.

classes.name: JsonWebKey
classes.description: A class for parsing JSON Web Key Sets, extracting keys, and decoding base64-encoded key data.

methods.name: extractKeysFromJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Parses a JSON Web Key Set string and populates a KeyMap with decoded key id-key pairs.

methods.name: decodeBase64String
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into a byte vector, handling padding as per the EME spec.

methods.name: findKey
methods.description: Finds and extracts the key id and key from a JSON object string, only allowing symmetric keys ('kty':'oct').

methods.name: findValue
methods.description: Finds the value associated with a key in the tokenized JSON string.

methods.name: isJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Checks if a JSON object string contains the 'keys' tag, indicating a JSON Web Key Set.

methods.name: parseJsonObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON object string into tokens using the jsmn parser.

methods.name: parseJsonWebKeySet
methods.description: Parses a JSON Web Key Set string into individual JSON object strings.
